definitions.explanation: A work arrangement that allows employees to choose their own daily start and end times within certain limits, while still fulfilling their required hours over a given period. A shortening of フレックスタイム (flextime), borrowed from English "flex."

examples.japanese: フレックス⟦で→で：00502_de⟧⟦{働|はたら}いている→働く：00503_hataraku⟧。
うち⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{会社|かいしゃ}→会社：00607_kaisha⟧⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧フレックス⟦{制度|せいど}→制度：03291_seido⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{導入|どうにゅう}している→導入する：16055_dounyuusuru⟧。
examples.english: Our company has introduced a flextime system.

examples.japanese: フレックスだ⟦から→から：00504_kara⟧、⟦{朝|あさ}→朝：02277_asa⟧{十時|じゅうじ}⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦{出社|しゅっしゃ}→出社：06155_shussha⟧⟦して→する：00392_suru⟧⟦も→も：00484_mo⟧⟦{大丈夫|だいじょうぶ}→大丈夫：00772_daijoubu⟧です。
examples.english: Because we're on flextime, it's fine to come in to work at ten in the morning.

examples.japanese: フレックス⟦{勤務|きんむ}→勤務：04545_kinmu⟧⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧⟦{子育|こそだ}て→子育て：12226_kosodate⟧⟦{中|ちゅう}→〜中：09840_chuu⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{社員|しゃいん}→社員：03065_shain⟧⟦にとって→にとって：06803_nitotte⟧⟦{便利|べんり}→便利：00830_benri⟧だ。
examples.english: Flextime work is convenient for employees who are raising children.

notes:
A shortening of フレックスタイム (flextime), commonly used in corporate and HR contexts. Under a typical Japanese フレックス system, there is a "core time" (コアタイム, usually something like 10:00–15:00) when employees must be present, and "flex time" bands before and after when they can choose their own start and end times.

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- フレックス⟦{制度|せいど}→制度：03291_seido⟧: flextime system
- フレックス⟦{勤務|きんむ}→勤務：04545_kinmu⟧: flextime work
- フレックス⟦{出勤|しゅっきん}→出勤：04548_shukkin⟧: flextime attendance
- フレックス⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{導入|どうにゅう}する→導入する：16055_dounyuusuru⟧: to introduce flextime
- フレックス⟦{対応|たいおう}→対応：02510_taiou⟧: flextime-eligible (of a job or role)

SIMILAR WORDS:
- フレックスタイム: flextime (full form) — identical meaning, more formal
- ⟦{時差|じさ}{出勤|しゅっきん}→時差出勤：08594_jisashukkin⟧: staggered working hours — employees choose from set start times rather than fully flexible
- ⟦テレワーク→テレワーク：05397_terewaaku⟧: telework, remote work — a different kind of flexible arrangement
- ⟦{裁量|さいりょう}→裁量：07285_sairyou⟧{労働制|ろうどうせい}: discretionary labor system — a stricter alternative in which fixed daily hours are no longer tracked

USAGE:
In everyday speech, フレックス can be used as a standalone noun meaning "flextime system" or "flextime work arrangement." It is most common in the context of Japanese office jobs and ⟦{働|はたら}き{方|かた}{改革|かいかく}→働き方改革：23313_hatarakikatakaikaku⟧ (work-style reform).
